# betterado_test_run (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_test_run" "example" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  run_id     = "12345"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `run_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `completed_date` (String)
- `failed_tests` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `passed_tests` (Number)
- `started_date` (String)

- `total_tests` (Number)
